confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Madrid prices, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are more reliable; July lodging rates are seasonal and could vary widely. Cocktail and wine are set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.75 times beer; wine by the glass near the beer price) where direct knowledge is weaker. EUR converted at an assumed rough 1.15 USD per EUR.
comparable_city_reasoning: Direct Madrid estimate from general knowledge of Spanish capital-city pricing; no price transfer from another city was applied.

anchor_basis.beer: draft lager (about 330 ml) at a neighborhood restaurant, about 4.00 EUR
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a sit-down cafe, about 2.50 EUR
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: menu del dia set lunch with starter, main, dessert and drink at a neighborhood restaurant, about 15 EUR
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course dinner for two at a mid-range restaurant, no drinks, about 80 EUR total
anchor_basis.cocktail: gin and tonic at a central bar, about 11 EUR (roughly 2.75 times the beer example)
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house wine by the glass at a restaurant, about 3.75 EUR

anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room at a registered central hostel, about 80 EUR per night
